incidents.title: Infoblox Portal Access Issues EU Region

incidents.body:
Between April 29 and May 6 (UTC) 2026, phased upgrades will be performed on NIOS-X server platform components. These updates will follow the ‘Schedule Software Updates’ configuration set in the Infoblox Portal. 

Impact: During this period, NIOS-X servers connected to Infoblox Portals North America (https://portal.infoblox.com) and Europe (https://portal.eu.infoblox.com) may intermittently report an unhealthy status, with each occurrence lasting up to 2–3 minutes.

All other services will remain unaffected, and there will be no impact on protocol services.
incidents.title: Scheduled Maintenance: Infoblox NIOS-X Server Platform Components
Traffic Reroute – Singapore

incidents.body:
Due to an ongoing issue with AWS services in the Bahrain region, Threat Defense DNS traffic originating from the Bahrain site has been temporarily rerouted to the nearest available sites to ensure service continuity.

Impact: Customers attempting to connect to our Global and Regional Anycast IP addresses (52.119.41.100, 52.119.41.61, 103.80.6.100 & 103.80.6.61) may experience traffic being rerouted to the nearest sites. Please note that no service interruption is expected.

Please follow the KB article https://support.infoblox.com/s/article/DNS-Traffic-Rerouting-Due-to-AWS-Issue-in-Bahrain-Region for latest details. If you are experiencing a service impact or require further assistance, please contact our support team at https://support.infoblox.com/.
incidents.title: Traffic Reroute – Bahrain Site
Issue with accessing Infoblox Portal in North America Region

incidents.body:
We will continue to reroute DNS traffic from the Bahrain site to the nearest available sites to avoid any service interruption until AWS restores services in the affected region. 

Please follow the KB article - https://support.infoblox.com/s/article/DNS-Traffic-Rerouting-Due-to-AWS-Issue-in-Bahrain-Region for latest details.
 
If you are experiencing a service impact or require further assistance, please contact our support team at https://support.infoblox.com/

This scheduled maintenance is a continuation of the previously announced NIOS-X server platform upgrades from January 19 to January 23 (UTC). For more details, refer to the earlier notification: https://status.infoblox.com/incidents/yzmr4l8wf8f0. 

To complete the remaining phases of the maintenance, the upgrades will continue during an extended maintenance window between January 27 and January 30 (UTC). The updates will follow the “Schedule Software Updates” configuration set in the Infoblox Portal.

Impact: During this period, NIOS-X servers connected to Infoblox Cloud (https://portal.infoblox.com) may report an unhealthy status a couple of times, each lasting up to 2–3 minutes.

All other services will remain unaffected, and there will be no impact on protocol services.

Intermittent Domain Resolution Impact Related to Threat Feed

incidents.body:
As part of the maintenance announced in-https://status.infoblox.com/incidents/9zllwkk7wk60, we observed that multiple on-prem hosts briefly entered a degraded state during the deployment. There was no service impact, and all services continued to operate normally. The behavior was caused by a temporary health-check failure on the hosts during the deployment process.
All hosts have now fully recovered, and services continue to operate normally. If you experience any issues, please contact Infoblox Support.

incidents.body: The issue with UDDI reports and dashboards have been resolved. The issue with the Bogon feed is also fixed now.
